proposals.evidence: The full DEDR 410 article gives Tulu: imbe, mōḷu/imbā̆ḷ/imboḷu, mērů/mōkuḷu/imberů, indů , [see 557( a ) Ta. u] this man, this woman, these persons, this thing, [these things]; adj. ī; ītů so much, so many; mūḷu, muḷḷu, muḷpa, muḷḷa here; muḷta of this place; iḍa, iḍe, iḍegů, iñci hither; īpe, īmbe adv. this…. Lindgren records indɯ “third-person singular, inanimate, proximate” in the same lexical family. The same article is independently returned by Jambu’s exact-form homepage search.

proposals.evidence: The full DEDR 5151 article gives Tulu: ērů, ēraṇe who; dā, dānè, jānè, dāva, dādavu, vā, ovu what, which; dāye why; ēni, ēpa, ēpo when; ētů how much, how many; ētoḷu how often; eñca how; eñci what sort of; eñcitti such as what; ōḷu, oḷpa where; oḍe whither; oñci whence; (B-K.) ōpe which side; ōpetāyé which man.. Lindgren records eñci “what” in the same lexical family. The same article is independently returned by Jambu’s exact-form homepage search.
